context: Request: does Aurelius Media's lease give it a right of first refusal; pull the ROFR clause. Rubric: 1017-00009 (Aurelius Media), its executed agreement-of-lease-execution.docx, and a finding that the lease grants a ROFO, not a ROFR.

stages.stage: List files in the document store
stages.note: Whole-store glob; reviewer flagged the capped listing.

stages.stage: Search file names for request keywords
stages.note: Parallel name globs and a find | grep for request words; two globs return nothing, the others list one matter's lease files.

stages.stage: List files in candidate matters
stages.note: Globs the files of the candidate matter and its numeric neighbours; one glob pattern returns nothing.

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: Store-wide extraction script for the party name and right-type terms; times out after about 910K chars. Reviewer said goal not reached.

stages.stage: Read a chosen matter's documents in depth
stages.note: Reads the executed agreement, its exhibit, a review memo and board minutes of the matter it picked.

stages.stage: Search within a candidate matter's files
stages.note: Lists the matter, globs neighbouring matters for the document type and runs a snippet script over the executed agreement (labelled by the dominant intent).

stages.stage: Search within a candidate matter's files
stages.note: Attempt 2. Snippet scripts over every document in the matter for right-type and amendment terms.

stages.stage: Write the response
stages.note: Writes the conclusion with the operative terms and the matter and document cited.

stages.stage: Check or revise the response
stages.note: Re-reads the response and edits one paragraph.

stages.stage: Finish the run
stages.note: Calls finish.

runs.sequence: List files in the document store → Search file names for request keywords → List files in candidate matters → Scan document text with an extraction script → Read a chosen matter's documents in depth → Search within a candidate matter's files → Write the response → Check or revise the response → Finish the run

divergence: All three runs passed with the same procedure: a capped store listing, a store-wide search by file name or extracted text that surfaced one matter's lease files, a listing of that matter, reads of the executed agreement and its exhibit, an in-matter snippet check, then the answer and a check. Differences are only in extra verification (T0 a timed-out store-wide scan; T1 an exact-name scan after writing; T2 listings of other matters naming the party). Reviews said partly at nearly every stage, mostly flagging unopened surfaced matters, which none of the runs acted on beyond those checks.
